title: The Falls
hook: It stands at the water. Don't breathe.
synopsis: The Hush is faster down the valley. Ahead, the old falls pour over the line, and Rook takes the dark train in behind the water.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Next stop: Falls Town. Hold the bar!
The lamps went out. It's here.
It's coming down the valley. Full steam!
It's faster than us! Come on, old girl!
Listen... the old falls. I have an idea.
Behind the water. Nice and slow.
Lights off. Fire out. Not a sound.
The water is loud. It can't hear us.
It's here. Right in front of us.
Ha! It doesn't like the cold water!
It's going down the river. Lights on!
Full steam! Out the far side!
Falls Town! Thank you, old falls.
It will be back. Hold the bar.
